names.iupac: 1H-Indole-3-ethanamine, N,N-dimethyl- (CAS index name, as listed by NIST); 2-(1H-indol-3-yl)-N,N-dimethylethanamine
cas: 61-50-7: N,N-dimethyltryptamine (NIST, read twice). The DEA Diversion Control Division sheet (December 2025) prints 'CAS 31-50-7' (read twice); the DEA number is not a valid CAS Registry Number (its check digit does not match), so the sheet appears to carry a misprint.

forms.detail: The DEA sheet names ayahuasca and hoasca among brewed concoctions containing DMT. NIDA (2015) describes ayahuasca (also hoasca, aya, yagé) as a brew made from one of several Amazonian plants containing DMT together with a vine containing a natural alkaloid; neither source names the plant species.
DEA: South American snuffs and various plant material.
DEA: produced synthetically in clandestine laboratories.
